# Meshopt decoder

`meshopt_decoder.mjs` is copied without modification from the npm package `meshoptimizer@1.2.0`.

Author: Arseny Kapoulkine. License: MIT, reproduced in `meshoptimizer-LICENSE.md`.

Upstream: https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer

Used by Three.js GLTFLoader for the experiment's `EXT_meshopt_compression` asset. The decoder is served locally.
